title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 118 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 118 - Deduction of Tax from Income Received from Lotteries, etc For wining in lotteries, jackpots, card games, online games or games of any similar nature if any amount is received, the person responsible for payment shall deduct tax at the rate of 20% (twenty percent) while making such payment. Explanation.- For the purposes of this section, the expression “any amount” means the value of any goods or property whereby the prize is paid in cash or by assets.
